CustomField.description: The deal phase this checklist group belongs to. The four values are BYTE-IDENTICAL to the first four values of Transaction__c.Stage__c, including the hyphen in Post-Closing - not the Closing and Post Closing spellings the LWC and the FlexiPage tabs currently use. Anything else makes a cross-object report join impossible. Closed is deliberately absent: no task group belongs to the terminal stage. NO DEFAULT VALUE, deliberately - a plausible default would hide a fan-out that failed to stamp the phase, whereas a blank is visible.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Deal phase this group belongs to. Stamped when the checklist is created from the group definition.
CustomField.label: Stage
